title: iOS 14 Home Screen widgets
lede: The 2020 iPhone Home Screen on which widgets of three sizes sit in the same grid as the app icons.
summary: Rounded widgets in small, medium, and large sizes share one grid with app icons on the iPhone Home Screen. iOS 14, 2020.

source.label: Apple Newsroom: Apple reimagines the iPhone experience with iOS 14 (2020-06-22)

evidence.note: Inspected the press image `Apple_ios14-widgets-redesigned_06222020_inline.jpg.large_2x.jpg` (1306 × 1770) from the Apple Newsroom release. It is an Apple marketing render of the Home Screen, not a device screenshot. Not stored.

styles.note: Partial fit, as a precursor: rounded tiles of three sizes share one grid with even gaps, but app icons and a wallpaper fill the rest of the screen.

context: Apple’s release says that the new widgets “present timely information at a glance and can be pinned in different sizes on any Home Screen page”.
The WWDC 2020 summary slide for iOS 14 shows the widgets in one of its tiles ([slide](ref:apple-wwdc-2020-ios-14-summary-slide)).
observed: An iPhone shows a Home Screen over an orange, red, blue, and grey wallpaper of large curved shapes.

Three widgets sit in the icon grid: a black Activity widget the size of four icons, a Photos widget of the same size with a portrait and the white condensed words “FRIENDS Sep 10, 2019”, and a white Music widget with an album cover.
The widgets have the same large corner radius as the app icons, scaled up, and they line up with the icon rows and columns.
The Activity widget sets its figures large in three colors on black: “375/500CAL” in red, “19/30MIN” in yellow-green, and “4/12HRS” in cyan.
interpretation: Widgets in fixed multiples of the icon cell are a bento grid in miniature, and Apple shipped them on every iPhone two years before the name spread. Interpretation: no source in this record says that the widgets inspired the web trend.
borrow: Size tiles as whole multiples of one base cell (1 × 1, 2 × 2, 4 × 2), so that any mix of tiles lines up.
Give a status tile a dark fill and set its figures large in a few signal colors.
